distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.3661 +/- 0.0179 mas (same row, RUWE 0.89): 186.36 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.016 +/- 0.035 solar radii from Peluso et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TIC 139270665 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..170P/abstract): 706,831 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.035 +/- 0.052 solar masses from Peluso et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TIC 139270665 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..170P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5844 +/- 84 K from Peluso et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TIC 139270665 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..170P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
